Experimental interpretation: LFP propagation duration is 4.64 times longer.
Engineering implication: Slower propagation may provide more time for protective actions, but usable response time is not established.
Limitation: TR onset estimates remain preliminary. Cell geometries and heating powers differ.

Experimental interpretation: LFP mean inter-cell delay is 4.64 times longer.
Engineering implication: Thermal barriers and cooling strategies should be evaluated against chemistry-specific propagation times.
Limitation: Mean delay is based on four transitions per chemistry. It is not a physical front velocity.

Experimental interpretation: NMC811 mean sensor Tmax is 356.91 °C higher.
Engineering implication: Higher measured temperatures indicate a greater local thermal load on nearby components under the tested conditions.
Limitation: Different numbers of thermocouples are used. NMC811 T5 is excluded; LFP T1 is close to its reported damage time. Tmax is not total heat release.

Experimental interpretation: NMC811 mean venting-sensor Tmax is 602.87 °C higher.
Engineering implication: Gas routing, vent placement, thermal shielding and ignition prevention are important design considerations for both chemistries.
Limitation: Sensor position can change during venting. Gas volume, composition and total released heat are not determined by this temperature metric.

Experimental interpretation: Propagation delays alone do not establish detection performance or intervention effectiveness.
Engineering implication: Evaluate detection thresholds, sensor placement, alarm latency, shutdown logic and venting response in dedicated system-level tests.
Limitation: No validated detection latency, suppression time or evacuation margin is available in step 22.

Experimental interpretation: Different thermal behaviors create different requirements for pack-level protection.
Engineering implication: Assess thermal barriers, cooling, gas management, structural protection and packaging together with energy-density requirements.
Limitation: The experimental cells were not electrically connected. Results cannot be transferred directly to a complete automotive battery pack.
